Title: Vihaan and the Family

Cast

1. Vihaan - 10 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Sonali - 39 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Karan - 36 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Aditya - 12 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
5. Zoya - 9 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Sonali, Karan and Zoya stand near him.]

Karan: "Let's do something fun today."

[Vihaan puts on his school uniform.]

Karan: "One more time!"

[Vihaan serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Vihaan (excited): "What happened?"

[Vihaan mops the floor.]

Karan: "Hmm, I see."

[Vihaan reads a storybook.]

Zoya (happily): "Hmm, I see."

[Vihaan talks to his father on the phone.]

Sonali: "That was fun!"

[Vihaan sits down on a chair.]

Sonali: "That's great!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Sonali and Aditya stand near him.]

Vihaan: "What a nice place."

[Vihaan trips over a stone.]

Vihaan (laughing): "Okay, Mom."

[Vihaan helps Mother get up.]

Vihaan: "I knew it!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

Vihaan: "What a nice place."

[Vihaan sings a song.]

Vihaan: "That's great!"

[Vihaan gives Mother a flower.]

Vihaan: "I really enjoyed today."
